title: Jean R NDE 280
content: I suddenly was aware I was a spirit looking down at my body. The relatives in the room were arguing over who could comb my hair. My mother sat quietly in a chair. My grandfather was talking to someone who appeared to be God but it was actually only light. I could not see God but I could hear his voice. My grandfather was asking God to let me stay with him. I was a good person. My grandfather's pet boxer was with him on a leash. I could feel the love between the dog and my grandfather. God reviewed my life. I felt some fear as I felt I was being judged and was not good enough for God. God told me I did something good that pleased him and seemed to try to ease my fears. It was something about helping a boy child in some way. God appeared only as a light and an authoritative voice. I could not see him. Afterwards he asked me if I wanted to stay or go back. I thought for a second and was given a vision of the future wherein my mother would get cancer. I felt in my heart that she would need me as I told God nobody would be there to help her. At that point, I returned to my body. My mother did get breast and cancer, and of the uterus later on, and I was her main support. That was probably fifteen years ago.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Yes Suicide attempt in coma on llife-support In comma due to overdose -- on life support. Family told to prepare for my death. Given last rites.
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Presence of deceased persons | Light | Strong emotional tone | Life review | Vision of the future | Presence of unearthly beings
elements.Did time seem to speed up or slow down?: Everything seemed to be happening at once; or time stopped or lost all meaning
elements.Please compare your hearing during the e: Grandfather and God were talking though.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes Grandfather, his dog, and the light of God.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Definitely there is a spiritual level that brings us to the dimension I reached, and surely there are other levels.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control I did not know such an experience could happen. Yes, it assured me there is an afterlife, we will be judged, and God does love us, but we must try to do our best to live the life that is pleasing in his eyes. Yes, the most important part of earthly life is your relationship with God, and his people.
elements.Did scenes from the future come to you?: Scenes from the world's future Very accurate. I visioned my mother getting cancer. She did get it and I was her sole support, as I felt I would be.
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will See narrative.
elements.God, Spiritual and Religion: point of no return? I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will See narrative. God, Spiritual and Religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes It proved the afterlife is very real and we should be prepared.
elements.After the NDE: included: Presence of unearthly beings After the NDE
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: No I, as a child, had an ability to foresee occurrences of my life in the future which always happen as I see it. They usually are bad experiences which I cannot seem to change.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Fear of being judged and not knowing if God would accept me. God talking to me and reassuring me everything will be okay. God sharing the future with me and sending me back, as if it were my decision, but the one God knew I would choose.
elements.Have you ever shared this experience wit: Yes As a faith sharing experience. It reassures people of the afterlife, and judgment and love.
elements.Is there anything else that you would li: It only reminds me, God is so powerful and so real.
